sloka: इत्येवं विलपन् दीन: प्रस्विन्नमुखपङ्कज:।पादावप्राप्य रामस्य पपात भरतो रुदन् ॥ २.९९.३७॥
transliteration: ityevaṁ vilapan dīna: prasvinnamukhapaṅkaja:।pādāvaprāpya rāmasya papāta bharato rudan ॥ 2.99.37॥

translations.english: Thus Bharata lamented in misery and with his lotuslike countenanace sweating before reaching Rama's feet fell down, crying in distress.
